from.place: ## Proof, step (b) Essential surjectivity: algebraization through formal glueing, specifically the torsion-extension descent used in Proposition 05ER

title: Extension descent assembles from summands of the quotient
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a flat map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], $N$ an $R$-module and $(C_j)_{j\in J}$ any family of $R$-modules. Put $P=\bigoplus_{j\in J}C_j$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules]. Assume that for each $j$ every $S$-module extension $0\to N\otimes_RS\to T_j\to C_j\otimes_RS\to0$ is isomorphic, with its end terms fixed, to the base change of an $R$-module extension $0\to N\to E_j\to C_j\to0$. Then every $S$-module extension $0\to N\otimes_RS\to T\to P\otimes_RS\to0$ is likewise isomorphic, with its end terms fixed, to the base change of an $R$-module extension $0\to N\to E\to P\to0$ [def-weil-module-base-change], [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. The family $J$ need not be finite.
